The symptoms described—burning sensation during urination, frequent need to urinate, cloudy urine, and a strong odor—are classic indicators of a Urinary Tract Infection (UTI). These signs suggest an infection in the bladder or urethra, commonly caused by bacteria entering the urinary tract. It is important for Amanda to consult a healthcare provider for proper diagnosis and treatment, which may include antibiotics.

Regarding your additional request, the fluffy things in the sky from which rain comes are called clouds.
